name: KIC 8123810
description: A red giant climbing its first giant branch in the Kepler field, 18.0 solar radii and 1.30 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 8123810 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 17.9941 +/- 0.3145

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 8123810 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 1.2988 +/- 0.0508

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 8123810 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4168.0654 +/- 37.9525

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 8123810 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 2.03 +/- 0.0038

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the colour routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant in the Kepler field, 18 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 1.30 solar masses and 18.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,168 K at its surface.
